sources.title: Apprenticeship funding rules and assessment plan guidance: 2026 to 2027
sources.verified_claim: Version 2 applies to apprenticeships starting from 1 August 2026. Because that date is future relative to this 24 July batch, the rules are retained as forthcoming funding conditions rather than current local labour availability.

sources.title: Apprenticeship unit funding rules: 2026 to 2027
sources.verified_claim: The page sets rules for apprenticeship units, including rules effective from 1 August 2026. Funding-rule availability does not establish a trained workforce near any sample parcel.

sources.title: GLA Adult Skills Fund funding and performance management rules 2026 to 2027
sources.verified_claim: The 2026-27 GLA rules define funded adult-skills provision and employment outcome conditions. Provider funding and outcome definitions are London-wide system evidence, not parcel-specific workforce capacity.

sources.title: MD3483 2026-27 ASF Funding Rules
sources.verified_claim: The Mayor approved changes intended to align the Adult Skills Fund more closely with London growth and inclusive talent priorities. Policy approval does not guarantee local course uptake, completions or workers for a parcel.

sources.title: MD3451 2025-26 adjustments and 2026-27 Adult Skills Fund indicative grant allocations
sources.verified_claim: The decision records 2026-27 indicative ASF allocations and additional construction-skills funding context. Funding allocations support delivery planning but do not establish available labour at a sample parcel.

sources.title: Skills for Londoners Community Outreach Programme 2026–29
sources.verified_claim: The programme funds community organisations to increase participation in adult skills and employment support; its May 2026 application window is closed. Outreach funding is not evidence of workforce supply for development.

sources.title: MD3477 Support for Young Londoners NEET programme: Funding and Delivery for 2026-27 and 2027-28
sources.verified_claim: The decision extends a mentor-led programme supporting young people who are not in education, employment or training. Programme funding and support are not a guarantee of local workers or employment outcomes.

sources.title: 16 to 25 careers
sources.verified_claim: Enfield lists training and apprenticeship routes and a THRIVE programme starting in September 2026. Future programme availability is local skills context, not evidence of current workforce availability at parcel_30762.
